visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot shows a pile of golden-brown, crispy-looking food strips seasoned with red spices and white sesame seeds, garnished with green celery leaves on a dark plate. (2) Hands enter the frame, tearing one of the strips in half to reveal a fibrous, layered interior texture against a blurred kitchen background. (3) On a wooden cutting board, a person's hands use a knife to slice folded pale yellow bean curd skins into long, thick rectangular strips. (4) The strips are laid out on white paper towels, and a hand presses down on them with another towel to remove moisture under bright, even lighting. (5) The strips are dropped into a deep pan filled with bubbling hot oil, where they fry and turn from pale yellow to a vibrant golden-brown as they are turned with black tongs. (6) In a clean dark pan, oil and white granulated sugar are added; the pan is tilted and swirled until the sugar melts into a clear, slightly amber liquid over a gas stove. (7) The fried strips are tossed back into the pan with the melted sugar; various red and brown spice powders, chili oil, and white sesame seeds are poured from small glass containers over the strips. (8) The strips are vigorously tossed and stirred with a red and black spatula until they are evenly coated in a glossy, spicy seasoning, ending with a close-up of the final dish.
